description:
No Nonsense Neovim Client in Rust


Neovim 0.12+ is now required
hey there everyone! from now on, we have decided to raise the minimum neovim version to 0.12+ in #3588. this also applies when using WSL or connecting to a remote neovim server. If you need an older neovim version, use an earlier Neovide release that supports it.

Features
- feat: support neovim :connect by @falcucci in #3614
- macOS: add a custom native Editors window switcher by @falcucci in #3527
- macos: add split-aware scrollbars at both outer window padding by @falcucci in #3589
- handoff: Add neovim-bin and neovim arguments by @CGamesPlay in #3440
- feat: settings for menu shortcuts on macOS by @vapourismo in #3481
- macos: add system window proxy icon support by @falcucci in #3494
- add startup-message capture settings by @falcucci in #3517
- handle neovim bufwrite progress events by @falcucci in #3546

Bug Fixes
- fix: panicking on zero-height grids by @falcucci in #3487
- fix: track reasonable cmdline modes and reset springs on immediate cursor moves by @falcucci in #3484
- fix: avoid fullscreen on new tab windows if already set by @falcucci in #3496
- fix event loop CPU spin without deadline by @falcucci in #3503
- fix: surface startup errors before first grid - 0.12+ only by @falcucci in #3504
- windows: fix overlapped pipe read crash by @windexlight in #3505
- fix: parsing neovim api function parameters by @onion108 in #3530
- fix: ignore unrelated config directory events by @fzlzjerry in #3545
- fix: render COLRv1 fonts on Linux by @fzlzjerry in #3544
- bridge: handle quit callbacks without an exit code by @falcucci in #3583
- fix: harden neovim restart handling by @BreezeDelegate in #3552
- fix: preserve Windows file drop paths by @BreezeDelegate in #3553
- fix: preserve channel properties across :restart by @falcucci in #3591
- fix: request activation for wayland focus commands by @falcucci in #3592
- fix --wayland-app-id option by @falcucci in #3594
- fix: avoid startup crashes when configured fonts are missing by @falcucci in #3595
- fix: keep grid contents when win_pos reports a stale window size by @SirVer in #3612

Performance and visual polish
- Cursor Polish by @Kethku in #3543
- batch wheel scrolls by @falcucci in #3562
- fill fractional bottom edge backgrounds by @falcucci in #3572

Documentation
- update homebrew installation docs. by @falcucci in #3582
- docs: add new :NeovideHelp as immediate forward by @falcucci in #3587
- fix(docs): escape / in autocmd pattern by @pilgrimlyieu in #3570

- moving macos switcher to window wrapper by @falcucci in #3605

- chore: move error_handling.rs => errors/mod.rs by @falcucci in #3611
